source: A local-memory access can be served by cache when the data is present there. On a miss, however, the request travels farther through the hierarchy toward device memory. That is why a spill is not equivalent to “one ZXNAME0000XZ access every time,” but it can still add loads, stores, cache pressure, and long-latency dependencies
zh: 当数据存在于本地存储器时，可以通过高速缓存提供服务。然而，如果未命中，请求将通过层次结构进一步传播到设备内存。这就是为什么溢出并不等于“每次一次 ZXNAME0000XZ 访问”，但它仍然会增加负载、存储、缓存压力和长延迟依赖性
